popis:
A two-hour dose of technique and fine-tuning your skills, led by Katarína Tóthová (national downhill champion), before your weekend races or a weekend ride with your mates or parents. We'll cover everything from basic technique to pro cornering or jumping. We always adapt the programme to the current group of riders. 

We'll fine-tune technique on the Tehov pump track, which is made for exactly this kind of training.

Sessions always start at 17:00 and end at 19:00. Ideally arrive a few minutes early.


LOCATION:

The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. There are also plenty of trails nearby for technique coaching

On the pump track you'll practise pumping, flow and a few jumps for those who fancy it. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.

There's also a Skills centre – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride. Maybe even get into the basics of Trial a little.

You can also get to the park by train from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

Training is at your own risk, only after signing the Legal guardian's consent on site.

WHO THE CAMP IS FOR

The sessions are for children aged 8–14, with limited capacity, CZK 400 / 2 HRS. They can also be used as intensive training for a group from one team, whether enduro, downhill or cross-country.

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps and courses have limited capacity. Availability is shown as text, with details on request. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to kate.tothova@gmail.com or info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
